authorInfo.bio: Gilbert Abbott À Beckett (1811–1856) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Comic History of England" by Gilbert Abbott À Beckett is a humorous historical account written in the mid-19th century. The work seeks to present English history in an entertaining manner, blending factual storytelling with wit and satire.
